body:
Brookfield Real Assets Income Fund Inc. announces monthly distributions for Q4 2026, with payment details included.

Brookfield Real Assets Income Fund Inc. has announced its monthly distribution schedule for the fourth quarter of 2026, with distributions of $0.1180 per share for October, November, and December. The record and ex-dividend dates for each month are provided, with payments to be made on October 23, November 27, and December 24, 2026. Shares purchased after the respective ex-distribution dates will not qualify for these distributions. The distributions may consist of net investment income, capital gains, and/or return of capital, with a note that returns of capital do not necessarily indicate investment performance. The tax status of these distributions will be confirmed at the end of the year, with details to be shared with shareholders in early 2027. Additional information about the Fund is available on its website.

The announcement of monthly distributions for Q4 2026 reflects the Fund's commitment to returning value to its shareholders through consistent income payments.

The distribution amount of $0.1180 per share for each month signals stability and confidence in the Fund's financial health and recurring revenue streams.

This press release provides investors with important dates related to the distribution schedule, enhancing transparency and allowing for better financial planning.

The communication of potential tax implications for the distributions indicates the Fund's responsibility in keeping shareholders informed about their financial matters.

The announcement indicates that a portion of the distributions will be treated as a return of capital, which may suggest that the Fund is not generating sufficient income to cover its distributions, potentially signaling financial instability.

The need for stockholders to consult a financial advisor regarding the tax status of distributions may indicate that the financial implications of the distributions are complex and may not be favorable, which could concern investors.

The mention of principal loss being possible in the risk disclosure highlights inherent risks in investing in the Fund, which could deter potential investors.

What are the distribution amounts for Q4 2026?

The distribution amount is $0.1180 per share for October, November, and December 2026.

When are the record and payable dates for distributions?

The record dates are October 9, November 12, and December 10, while payable dates are October 23, November 27, and December 24, 2026.

What is the ex-dividend date for these distributions?

The ex-dividend dates are the same as the record dates: October 9, November 12, and December 10, 2026.

How will distributions affect my taxes?

A portion of the 2026 distributions is expected to be treated as return of capital, impacting your tax status.

Where can I find more information about the Fund?

Additional information about the Fund can be found on its website at https://privatewealth.brookfield.com/fund/brookfield-real-assets-income-fund-inc.
